exam_name: B.Tech (Machine Learning for Internet of Things + Electromagnetic Field Theory)
conducting_body: Veer Madho Singh Bhandari Uttarakhand Technical University
note: An alleged paper leak surfaced at Veer Madho Singh Bhandari Uttarakhand Technical University, prompting the administration to cancel two B.Tech semester examinations. Ashish Kumar Gupta, an Assistant Professor at Shivalik College of Engineering, was arrested for allegedly sharing questions with students.
The question paper was leaked on WhatsApp within five minutes of the exam commencement. Two individuals were arrested for their alleged involvement in the incident.
The alleged mastermind and an aide of the Maharashtra TET paper leak case were arrested from Bihar.
